children: Akash Network's AKT token migration to Solana begins by November 9, 2026. The announced migration puts liquidity first, setting the focus for the opening phase of the move to the destination network.
The start date does not mean the entire transition is complete. AKT's migration begins a longer process, with the full transition to Solana expected to take a couple of years.
Will take a couple years, but the token will start migrating in two weeks.
Optimizing for liquidity first, then eventually this whole system.

title: Akash Network: AKT token migration to Solana begins - By 09 Nov 2026
